title: Smoother motion
summary: Pages, dialogs and notifications now move with the same springy squash as the scanner tabs.

changes.text: Switching pages slides the new page in from the direction you're going, with a squash-and-stretch like the scanner tabs.
Dialogs (material details, scanner settings, scan review and the material picker) squash open and shrink away when closed, instead of popping in and out.
Notifications are frosted glass like the rest of the app, tinted by type, and land with a little squash.
Material cards squash when you hover them instead of lifting, and the page bar on the Materials page wiggles when you change page.
